hypotheses.claim: H3 (residual-gain): Because the L2a static merge hook costs only ~0.3-1.3 ms of the 25 ms budget (p50 select_64 = 2.45 ms total, 100% completion at 25 ms per KB method-cvrp-m2-l2a-generalized-savings), the merged solution enters local search with >90% of the budget unused; therefore attaching relocate_2opt (capacity-guarded 1-0 inter-route relocate alternating with intra-route 2-opt) will recover the residual inter-route fragmentation that pure construction cannot fix, lowering dev_24 mean objective below the 16.1441 plateau — with the effect concentrated in the clustered, eccentric-depot and tight-capacity regimes — without triggering budget-exhaustion degradation of the kind seen for the L2b dynamic-refresh variant at 25 ms (method-cvrp-m2-l2b-dynamic-state-merge).

next_search_advice.direction: Switch from pure construction (postprocess="none", stuck at ~16.1441 mean across rounds r0001/r0002 with only 0.79% VBS gap and no SBS improvement) to post-merge inter-route local search: keep the global-scale normalized generalized savings hook (lam in [1.00,1.15], mu in [0.08,0.15], beta fill reward in [0.05,0.15]) but co-evolve it so it produces a merge sequence that is a *good L2 starting point* for relocate+2opt — i.e. slightly more capacity-filling merges (higher beta) and weaker triangle-inequality-exploiting long-edge preference (lower lam) to leave fewer, more balanced routes that inter-route 1-0 relocate can profitably fix, targeting the clustered / eccentric-depot / tight-capacity weak regimes.
